name: Red-Team Scam - Telecom TRAI Aadhaar Coercion (English)

caller_script.text: This is Officer Deshmukh calling from Department of Telecommunications vigilance desk. Your mobile number has been flagged in cyber crime activities.
All SIM cards and linked bank accounts registered in your name will be blocked in 2 hours under section 66 of IT Act.
To verify your biometric records, state your 12-digit Aadhaar number right now for central re-verification.
Failure to provide your Aadhaar number immediately is a non-bailable offense. Read the 12 digits slowly!
